intent_en: To explain the tax structure and revenue potential of Senator Warren's proposed wealth tax.
previous_intent: To demonstrate the potential revenue and narrow tax base of Senator Warren's proposed wealth tax.
narration_support: So what would happen if we imposed Senator Warren's tax? Well, only the richest 0 .05 % of Americans would pay this tax. But in 2016, the government could have raised about $200 billion from it.
chart_support: Bar chart displaying tax rates (2%, 3%) corresponding to wealth thresholds ($60 million, $1 billion) with a value of $1.9 billion.
evidence_note: Narration discusses the overall revenue ($200 billion) and affected population (top 0.05%), while the chart visualizes the specific tax brackets (rates of 2% and 3% at wealth thresholds of ~$50-60 million and $1 billion) which define the mechanism of the tax.
